build_message_waymo_frame: build a waymo open dataset Frame message with context, camera images, lasers, and laser labels
create_message_label: create a Label message with 3D bounding box, type, id, and difficulty levels for vehicle detection
build_message_camera_calibration: build a CameraCalibration message with intrinsic matrix, extrinsic transform, width, height, and rolling shutter direction
build_message_laser_calibration: build a LaserCalibration message with beam inclinations, min, max, and extrinsic transform
summarize_message_context: summarize the Context message containing camera and laser calibrations with object counts, location, weather, and time of day
